method.fpsDefinition: 1000 divided by the arithmetic mean requestAnimationFrame interval; first interval discarded.
method.renderCounts: One composed frame including rendering passes, not unique scene geometry.
limitations: Short, stationary samples on one local computer; not hardware-independent guarantees.
The eight stress enemies remain naturally positioned in the world; they are not all placed in front of the camera.
High rendering resolution changed from ratio 1.5 to 1.35, so earlier measurements are not a comparison at equal resolution.
Only the three archivedScreenshot paths are retained in the repository; filename records preserve temporary capture provenance.
